label: preparing
what: Likely a jubilee gathering or feast in the great hall at day 1, 18:00, with 200 loaves and new lighting, presented to the mayor as only a lighting inspection. Innkeeper commissioned and directed bread storage; baker baked and delivered; freight supplied payment/grain and hauled bread; builder arranged lighting and precisely timed entry. The jubilee's beneficiary and exact purpose are not established. Secretary knowingly scheduled and escorted for an inspection, but the record does not establish knowledge of a concealed celebration; neighbour's knowing participation is also unsupported.
